Name: Absalom, Son of David
Summary: Third son of David, born in Hebron to Maachah daughter of Talmai.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:2: Third son of David, born in Hebron to Maachah daughter of Talmai.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Absalom stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
